gpt-4o-mini.title: Gerald's Game
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: In Stephen King's psychological thriller, a couple's getaway turns into a nightmare when a game goes horribly wrong, forcing the protagonist to confront her darkest fears and memories. gpt-4o-mini.title: Later
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A unique blend of crime and supernatural elements, featuring a boy with the ability to see dead people.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Carrie
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: Stephen King's chilling debut novel, Carrie, tells the story of a bullied high school girl who discovers her telekinetic powers, leading to a dramatic and violent confrontation. This gripping tale explores themes of revenge, isolation, and the consequences of cruelty.

gemma2:9b.title: Later
gemma2:9b.explanation: A young boy with psychic abilities helps a detective solve crimes in this suspenseful thriller.

gemma2:9b.title: Everything's Eventual: 14 Dark Tales
gemma2:9b.explanation: A collection of chilling short stories by Stephen King, this anthology delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the supernatural, showcasing his signature blend of suspense and psychological depth. Each tale offers a unique exploration of fear, fate, and the unexpected twists of life.

gemma2:9b.explanation: This collection features a curated selection of horror stories from Cemetery Dance, showcasing the best in the genre, with contributions from Stephen King. It highlights themes of fear and the supernatural, appealing to fans of chilling narratives and masterful storytelling.
